blocks.en: Nonconvex Problems
blocks.zh: 非凸问题
blocks.label: subsec:nonconvex-variational-problems

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: The study of nonconvex variational problems has occupied a significant fraction of the PDE community over the last twenty years. Such problems arise in PDEs which model phase transitions, e.g. the liquid-gas transition, phase transitions is crystalline solids, ferromagnetism and superconductivity. We discuss the main issues which arise in a simple one-dimensional example.
blocks.zh: 过去二十年间, PDE 研究者中有相当一部分从事非凸变分问题的研究. 这类问题出现在描述相变的 PDE 中, 例如液气相变, 晶体固体中的相变, 铁磁性和超导性. 我们通过一个简单的一维例子讨论其中出现的主要问题.

blocks.en:
However, because of the nonconvex term, $I$ is not continuous in the way we might expect. That is even though the sequence of functions $u_n$ converges to zero uniformly, we have\[I\left(\lim_{n\to\infty}u_n\right)=I(0)=1\neq\lim_{n\to\infty}I(u_n).\]Indeed, it is easy to see that no function can possibly attain the minimum of $I$. Any function $u$ with $I(u)=0$ would have to satisfy $u=0$ and $u^{\prime}=\pm1$, but there is no such function.

The behavior found in this example turns out to be typical of nonconvex variational problems. There are two possible strategies to cope with this:\begin{enumerate}\item Identify the problem satisfied by the limits of minimizing sequences; obviously this will be a problem different from the original one.\item Actually define a ``function\textquotesingle\textquotesingle\ which is equal to zero but has derivative $\pm1$.\end{enumerate}In this section, we shall give a brief outline of each of these approaches.
blocks.zh:
然而, 由于存在非凸项, $I$ 并不以我们可能期待的方式连续. 即尽管函数序列 $u_n$ 一致收敛到零, 仍有\[I\left(\lim_{n\to\infty}u_n\right)=I(0)=1\neq\lim_{n\to\infty}I(u_n).\]事实上, 容易看出没有函数能够达到 $I$ 的极小值. 任何满足 $I(u)=0$ 的函数 $u$, 都必须同时满足 $u=0$ 和 $u^{\prime}=\pm1$, 但这样的函数并不存在.

这一例子中的现象实际上是非凸变分问题的典型现象. 有两种可能的应对策略:\begin{enumerate}\item 找出极小化序列的极限所满足的问题; 显然, 这将是不同于原问题的另一个问题.\item 真正定义一个等于零但导数为 $\pm1$ 的 ``函数\textquotesingle\textquotesingle.\end{enumerate}本节将分别简要介绍这两种方法.

blocks.en: How can one define a ``function\textquotesingle\textquotesingle\ which is equal to zero but has derivative $\pm1$? The solution to this dilemma is to assign probabilities rather than values to the derivative. The classical derivative is then the average of the probability distribution. This allows the function 0 to have derivatives $\pm1$, as long as both values occur with equal probability. The development of this theory, originally introduced by L.C. Young, rests on the following result (see \cite{Dac}).
blocks.zh: 如何定义一个等于零但导数为 $\pm1$ 的 ``函数\textquotesingle\textquotesingle? 解决这一困境的办法是给导数赋予概率, 而不是数值. 经典导数于是为概率分布的平均值. 只要两个值以相同概率出现, 这就允许函数 0 具有导数 $\pm1$. 这一最初由 L.C. Young 引入的理论, 其发展基于下面的结果 (见 \cite{Dac}).

blocks.en: Do the first step of the induction in the proof of Theorem~\ref{thm:gradient-minors-weak-continuity}; i.e., show that for any indices $i,j,l,m$ from 1 to $n$ we have\[\lim_{k\to\infty}\dfrac{\partial p_i^k}{\partial x_l}\dfrac{\partial p_j^k}{\partial x_m}-\dfrac{\partial p_i^k}{\partial x_m}\dfrac{\partial p_j^k}{\partial x_l}=\dfrac{\partial\overline p_i}{\partial x_l}\dfrac{\partial\overline p_j}{\partial x_m}-\dfrac{\partial\overline p_i}{\partial x_m}\dfrac{\partial\overline p_j}{\partial x_l}.\]
blocks.zh: 完成 Theorem~\ref{thm:gradient-minors-weak-continuity} 证明中归纳法的第一步; 即证明, 对从 1 到 $n$ 中任取的指标 $i,j,l,m$, 都有\[\lim_{k\to\infty}\dfrac{\partial p_i^k}{\partial x_l}\dfrac{\partial p_j^k}{\partial x_m}-\dfrac{\partial p_i^k}{\partial x_m}\dfrac{\partial p_j^k}{\partial x_l}=\dfrac{\partial\overline p_i}{\partial x_l}\dfrac{\partial\overline p_j}{\partial x_m}-\dfrac{\partial\overline p_i}{\partial x_m}\dfrac{\partial\overline p_j}{\partial x_l}.\]
